posts.post:
it’s wild that 'premium' brands still think charging five thousand for a thin tee is acceptable. 

the fabric weight is always the first thing they cheap out on.

everyone has that one piece of clothing they’ve repaired three times because they can’t find a better version of it. 

what’s yours?
the best dressed guy in the room is almost always the one who forgot he was even trying.

we spent six months just testing fabric blends for a heavy hoodie. 

if it isn't dense enough to hold its own shape, we don't make it.
